summary: Verified the 'Edit course' button fix on LearnPage. All 4 scenarios in the review request pass. Admin viewing /learn/243 sees learn-edit-course-btn in the header; clicking it navigates to /courses/243/edit where the imported IMAGE slide '01A Gym Floor' exposes all picture tools (slide-media-url, slide-image-upload-btn, slide-image-preview, image-position-picker with above/beside/behind chips, slide-image-upload-input). Uploading a 1x1 test PNG via slide-image-upload-input successfully updated the Media URL from /api/uploads/files/imports/327/utilizing-the-fitness-facility/01a-gym-floor.jpg to /api/uploads/files/branding/<uuid>.png (upload endpoint working). Save was intentionally NOT clicked to preserve user data. Learner uat-learner on /learn/224 does NOT see the edit button (count=0). /learn/9999 renders the friendly course-unavailable screen without crashing.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and scoped correctly: staff-gated Edit course button added to learn player header, non-destructive (navigation only). No changes needed to CourseEditPage — picture tools were already present and functional for IMAGE slides.
test_credentials: Admin uat-admin@ifpi.org / UatAdmin!2026, Learner uat-learner@ifpi.org / UatLearner!2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md conventions and review request)
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded a 1x1 test PNG to change the image slide's media URL in the editor form state, but did NOT click Save, so course 243 remains untouched in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug-fix verification only. Course 243 is REAL user-imported data (118-slide 'Utilizing the Fitness Facility (US 254459)') — never click Save while editing it. Course 224 is a published course usable by uat-learner. Welcome tour appears ~1s after fresh login; dismiss via [data-testid=welcome-tour-skip]. Backend cookies-based auth works; test token header remains disabled by design.
rca of the issue: Original bug was a UX misconception: user was in LEARNER player (/learn/243) expecting editing tools. Editor at /courses/243/edit already had full image tooling. Fix: added staff-only 'Edit course' shortcut in the learner header. Verified working.
